reason: Storage senders on a supervisor Core, hardened after a security review. The API worker authenticates POST /api/v1/storage/events, /inventory and /test with the source token and transport rule, validates every body before saving, answers /test itself, and saves reports as storage.report/v1 commands for the source's project under a storage-source principal bound to the token digest; it waits for the project worker in its own 4-slot pool for at most 5 s, gates on the storage.report/v1 release feature, chains a new run after a failed or interrupted one, and answers retryable problems with 503. Delivery confines the principal to report paths and revalidates it on replay; an interrupted report fails retryably (runner and claim) instead of blocking its lane; handoff and API promotion fence pending reports; authentication refuses the principal on operator routes; a replayed report records and wakes the dispatch loop; callbacks have an overall deadline. test_api_worker, test_runtime_principal, test_storage_integrations, test_storage_sender and the new test_storage_report_compatibility hold the regression tests for every confirmed review finding (each caught by a mutation pass); test_runtime_delivery, test_runtime_coordination, test_runtime_routing, test_deployment_lifecycle, test_chat_acceptance_compatibility, test_authentication_api, test_api_worker_composition, test_runtime_global_reads, test_runtime_global_api, test_runtime_work_batches and test_work_batch_contracts cover the delivery, claim, routing, deployment-fence, authentication and global paths these changes touch.
exclusions: No UI or native code changed. test_work_batch_contracts.py::test_project_admission_requires_an_exact_chat_start is excluded: its legacy-normal-command case has failed on origin/main since #1028 admitted workers for queued project commands. test_runtime_worker_features.py is excluded: its canonical-admission tests spawn real workers and fail identically on main on this host (execution role does not come up under load with a per-worktree venv); with that venv the API-role case passes on this branch, and the real-Core runs started execution workers from a release declaring storage.report/v1. test_product_knowledge.py is excluded (two search tests fail identically on main); the index builds and verifies with the edited docs. Playwright area storage-integrations is excluded: its real-Core fixture cannot complete provider turns on this host's saturated pressure gate and real-core.spec.ts is not run on main; the supervisor journey was checked on scratch Postgres supervisor Cores instead (invalid report 422 and not saved; sender report 202 and dispatched by the woken loop into its incident chat, which drained; /test 200; inventory 202 twice; operator token and revoked source 401).
